sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN POLITICAL SCIENCE
lines: Faculty of Social Science - Political Science
Enrollment in this module is limited. Meeting the minimum requirements does not guarantee that students wishing to transfer into this module will be offered enrollment.

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, including Political Science 1020E or both Political Science 1021F/G and Political Science 1022F/G or both Political Science 1025F/G and Political Science 1026F/G, plus 2.0 additional courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%.
0.5 course from: Political Science 2325F/G, Political Science 2350A/B, or acceptable substitute (must be pre-approved by the Department through Special Permission).
0.5 course: Political Science 3325A/B or acceptable substitute (must be pre-approved by the Department through Special Permission).
2.0 Political Science courses at the 2200 level or above.
3.0 Political Science designated essay courses (E, F or G) at the 3000 level or above.
1.0 Political Science designated essay course (E, F or G) at the 4000 level.

Note: Students registered in the Honours Specialization in Political Science may register in 2100-level Political Science courses. These courses may only be used as electives and cannot be counted towards the Honours Specialization in Political Science modular requirements.
